scripts.lint: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api ruff check scripts services/buyer-audit-api && uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api mypy services/buyer-audit-api/src && npm run lint --workspace @pbl/commerce-gateway && npm run lint --workspace @pbl/dashboard
scripts.test: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api pytest services/buyer-audit-api/tests && npm test --workspace @pbl/commerce-gateway && npm run test:schemas && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:dashboard && npm run test:mongo:local && npm run test:aegis:e2e
scripts.test:unit: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api pytest services/buyer-audit-api/tests -m 'not mongo'
scripts.test:mongo: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api pytest services/buyer-audit-api/tests -m mongo
scripts.api: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api uvicorn buyer_audit_api.main:app --app-dir services/buyer-audit-api/src --env-file .env.local --reload
